statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: packages/hoppscotch-common/src/helpers/**, packages/hoppscotch-selfhost-web/src/**. Do not edit forbidden paths: packages/hoppscotch-backend/**, packages/hoppscotch-sh-admin/**, **/generated/**, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.
